The submitted formulas for Var R, Cov(R,C), Var C, alpha*=Cov/Var and residual variance follow. Var C>0 ensures unique minimizer; k=1 yields zero residual and k>=2 strict positive. Along k=Q^2,q=Q the exact moments imply alpha_opt->1/2, alpha_mean_degree->1 and variance ratios 1/2 vs 1. Independent exact rational enumeration checked k=1..7 and four q values, including boundaries; infinite assertion from analytic conditional moment identities.
